name: Little Neck Plaza
summary: Little Neck Plaza is a 48,371 square foot neighborhood shopping center strategically located on the Long Island Expressway service road at the Queens/Nassau border. The center serves an affluent suburban market with excellent visibility and access to daily commuter traffic in one of New York's most desirable residential areas.
demographics: Little Neck Plaza serves an affluent suburban market on the Queens/Nassau border with a median household income of $117,752 within one mile and $119,135 within three miles. The trade area is characterized by established families and professionals with high educational attainment, reflected in the average household income of $170,846 within one mile. The center attracts daily commuters along the Long Island Expressway corridor, with a daytime population of nearly 294,000 within three miles, creating a strong customer base of convenience-oriented shoppers seeking everyday services and retail.
description: Little Neck Plaza is a well-positioned neighborhood shopping center located at 254-45 Horace Harding Expressway on the service road of the Long Island Expressway, strategically situated on the Queens/Nassau border in Little Neck, New York. This 48,371 square foot retail center benefits from exceptional visibility and access to daily NYC commuter traffic, serving one of the most affluent suburban markets in the New York metropolitan area. The center's location provides superior demographics, with median household incomes exceeding $117,000 within one mile and a trade area population of over 728,000 within five miles. Little Neck Plaza offers a convenient mix of retail and service tenants catering to the everyday needs of the surrounding residential community, including opportunities for various business types from restaurants to medical offices and specialty services. The property is professionally managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, ensuring quality maintenance and tenant services.
